mapper.select: select a.id as id, b.password as password, c.max_contacts as max_contacts, a.context as context, a.transport as transport, a.allow as allow, coalesce(a.record_yn, 'y') as record_yn, b.username as callerid, a.mobile_no as mobile_no, a.routing_mode as routing_mode, a.status as status, a.duty_yn as duty_yn from asterisk.ps_endpoints a left join asterisk.ps_auths b on a.id = b.id left join asterisk.ps_aors c on a.id = c.id where 1=1 and a.id like concat('%', #{id}, '%')

select name as name, musiconhold as musiconhold, strategy as strategy, timeout as timeout, ringinuse as ringinuse, context as context, failover_dest as failover_dest from asterisk.queues where 1=1 and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')

select replace(interface, 'pjsip/', '') as interface_no, membername as membername, penalty as penalty, paused as paused, wrapuptime as wrapuptime from asterisk.queue_members where queue_name = #{queue_name}

select context as context, exten as exten, priority as priority, app as app, appdata as appdata from asterisk.extensions where 1=1 and context like concat('%', #{context}, '%') and exten like concat('%', #{exten}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into asterisk.ps_auths (id, auth_type, password, username) values (#{id}, 'userpass', #{password}, #{id}) on duplicate key update password = #{password}
insert into asterisk.ps_aors (id, max_contacts, remove_existing) values (#{id}, coalesce(#{max_contacts}, 1), 'yes') on duplicate key update max_contacts = coalesce(#{max_contacts}, 1)

insert into asterisk.ps_endpoints (id, transport, aors, auth, context, disallow, allow, record_yn, callerid, force_rport, rewrite_contact, rtp_symmetric, direct_media, rtp_timeout, timers, mobile_no, routing_mode, status, duty_yn) values (#{id}, #{transport}, #{id}, #{id}, #{context}, 'all', #{allow}, coalesce(#{record_yn}, 'y'), #{callerid}, 'yes', 'yes', 'yes', 'no', 20, 'yes', #{mobile_no}, coalesce(#{routing_mode}, '10'), coalesce(#{status}, '10'), coalesce(#{duty_yn}, 'N')) on duplicate key update transport = #{transport}, context = #{context}, allow = #{allow}, record_yn = coalesce(#{record_yn}, 'y'), callerid = #{callerid}, mobile_no = #{mobile_no}, routing_mode = coalesce(#{routing_mode}, '10'), status = coalesce(#{status}, '10'), duty_yn = coalesce(#{duty_yn}, 'N'), force_rport='yes', rewrite_contact='yes', rtp_symmetric='yes', direct_media='no', rtp_timeout=20, timers='yes'

insert into asterisk.queues (name, musiconhold, strategy, timeout, ringinuse, context, failover_dest) values (#{name}, coalesce(#{musiconhold}, 'default'), #{strategy}, #{timeout}, #{ringinuse}, #{context}, #{failover_dest}) on duplicate key update musiconhold = coalesce(#{musiconhold}, 'default'), strategy = #{strategy}, timeout = #{timeout}, failover_dest = #{failover_dest}

insert into asterisk.queue_members (queue_name, interface, membername, penalty, paused, wrapuptime) values (#{queue_name}, concat('pjsip/', #{interface_no}), #{membername}, #{penalty}, #{paused}, #{wrapuptime})
insert into asterisk.extensions (context, exten, priority, app, appdata) values (#{context}, #{exten}, #{priority}, #{app}, #{appdata})
mapper.delete: delete from asterisk.extensions where context = #{context} and exten = #{exten}
mapper.select: SELECT id, description, script_text, upd_user, upd_dtime FROM asterisk.ars_scripts WHERE 1=1 AND id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{id}, '%') ORDER BY id ASC
